author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@jgmac1106 @heatherwalder Incognito doesn’t filter out IP address influences, right? Does DDG? (I’ve never considered this.) #digped

— Chris Friend (@chris_friend) August 12, 2015

As part of #digped folks were Googling themselves. I discussed how search results are now curated and influenced by those we follow, where we are, and what we have searched for in the past. So I googled myself three different ways. Despite my concerns the results were quite similar.

Duck-Duck-Go Google Signed-In Google InCognito
